svg.title: From CLI args to VllmConfig
svg.desc: from_cli_args copies the argparse Namespace into AsyncEngineArgs, so values the user did not set stay None or auto. create_engine_config fills them. ModelConfig comes first and takes dtype and max length from the Hugging Face config. Batch limits in SchedulerConfig come from the GPU memory size and the UsageContext of the entry point. Everything is combined into one VllmConfig, which AsyncLLM (subsection 4) and EngineCore (subsection 5) both receive.
